nodes.definition: Artificial intelligence, machine learning, neural networks, foundation models, and autonomous intelligent systems.

sibling_cues.evidence_needed: must reference a large language model

nodes.definition: Space exploration, astronautics, astrophysics, orbital mechanics, planetary science, and empirical scientific inquiry.

sibling_cues.evidence_needed: must reference space, not atmospheric flight

nodes.definition: Software engineering tooling, agent harnesses, IDE extensions, coding assistants, SDKs, and developer-focused workflows.
exclude: pure theoretical ML papers without tools

sibling_cues.evidence_needed: must be for software engineering tasks

nodes.definition: AI safety, cybersecurity, agent sandboxing, prompt injection defenses, vulnerability analysis, and governance guardrails.
exclude: generic network security without AI component

sibling_cues.evidence_needed: must be a technical guardrail mechanism
must be a security vulnerability with AI relevance
must apply to AI agent permissions

nodes.definition: Architectures, capability evaluations, multimodal systems, scaling behavior, and releases of frontier foundation models.
Lectures, pedagogical explanations, conceptual deep dives, tutorials, and fundamental principles of machine learning.

sibling_cues.evidence_needed: must cover math foundations of ML

nodes.definition: Rocket propulsion, orbital spaceflight missions, spacecraft operations, astronaut activities, and commercial launch systems.

sibling_cues.evidence_needed: must be an orbital rocket launch
must be a real crewed mission
must be a space station resupply mission

nodes.definition: Clips and commentary reporting or discussing real-world breaking incidents, crimes, armed conflicts, and political or social debates shared via social media and news broadcasts.
include: breaking reports naming a specific crime, riot, or armed-conflict incident
raw police/military radio or scanner audio captured during an unfolding event
political or cultural opinion segments from talk shows or panels
exclude: discussion of an AI/tech product or capability -> AI and ML
an AI agent or model demonstrated performing a task -> AI and ML / AI Agents and Automation
AI company business, market, or competitive commentary -> AI and ML / AI Industry and Business

sibling_cues.include_cue: breaking reports naming a specific crime, riot, or armed-conflict incident
sibling_cues.evidence_needed: quote must report a real-world incident (who/what/where), not a product or model capability

sibling_cues.include_cue: raw police/military radio or scanner audio captured during an unfolding event
sibling_cues.confusing_alternative: AI Agents and Automation product demo audio
sibling_cues.evidence_needed: audio must be dispatch/command radio about a security or military event, not an AI agent narrating a task

sibling_cues.include_cue: political or cultural opinion segments from talk shows or panels
sibling_cues.confusing_alternative: AI Industry and Business executive commentary
sibling_cues.evidence_needed: speakers must be debating ideology/policy on a social issue, not an AI company's competitive position

nodes.definition: AI systems, models, and pipelines that generate video, animation, or film content from prompts, and the finished creative outputs they produce.
include: prompt-driven generation of video, animation, or images explicitly described as AI-made
a named foundation model used specifically to produce a video, image, or animation output
an AI-generated film or video entered in or winning an AI-specific award or competition
an AI-generated video praised or showcased for its entertainment or creative value
exclude: model architecture, scaling, or benchmark evaluation without a shown creative output -> AI and ML / Frontier Models
an agent product performing a real-world task rather than generating creative media -> AI and ML / AI Agents and Automation
company financial, market, or competitive commentary about an AI company -> AI and ML / AI Industry and Business

sibling_cues.include_cue: prompt-driven generation of video, animation, or images explicitly described as AI-made
sibling_cues.evidence_needed: excerpt must show a prompt producing a specific visual output, not a benchmark or spec description

sibling_cues.include_cue: a named foundation model used specifically to produce a video, image, or animation output
sibling_cues.evidence_needed: excerpt must show the model being used to make a creative artifact, not describe the model's release/capabilities in the abstract

sibling_cues.include_cue: an AI-generated film or video entered in or winning an AI-specific award or competition
sibling_cues.confusing_alternative: AI Industry and Business market recognition
sibling_cues.evidence_needed: excerpt must reference the creative work itself receiving the award, not a company's business standing

sibling_cues.include_cue: an AI-generated video praised or showcased for its entertainment or creative value
sibling_cues.confusing_alternative: AI Agents and Automation task demo
sibling_cues.evidence_needed: excerpt must describe or react to the video/creative content itself, not an agent completing a task

nodes.definition: AI agent products and features that autonomously execute multi-step, real-world tasks and business workflows on a user's or company's behalf.
include: an agent autonomously completes a multi-step real-world task (booking, shopping, ordering) without step-by-step direction
an AI agent running an end-to-end business function (sales, underwriting, coaching, ad analysis) without human operators
a bot completing a concrete office or admin task on request (sending documents, messages)
an installed or locally-run AI agent whose autonomy or operating constraints are described
exclude: coding-specific agent harnesses, IDE tools, or SDKs for software engineers -> AI and ML / Developer Tools
the demoed output is a finished creative/video artifact rather than a task performed -> AI and ML / AI Generative Media
company financial, competitive, or market commentary without a task demo -> AI and ML / AI Industry and Business

sibling_cues.include_cue: an agent autonomously completes a multi-step real-world task (booking, shopping, ordering) without step-by-step direction
sibling_cues.evidence_needed: the task target must be a real-world consumer/business action, not code review or an IDE workflow

sibling_cues.include_cue: an AI agent running an end-to-end business function (sales, underwriting, coaching, ad analysis) without human operators
sibling_cues.confusing_alternative: AI Industry and Business company commentary
sibling_cues.evidence_needed: card must show the agent performing the task itself, not commentary about the company's competitive position

sibling_cues.include_cue: a bot completing a concrete office or admin task on request (sending documents, messages)
sibling_cues.evidence_needed: excerpt must describe the bot completing an office task, not a generated creative artifact

sibling_cues.include_cue: an installed or locally-run AI agent whose autonomy or operating constraints are described
sibling_cues.confusing_alternative: AI Industry and Business infrastructure story
sibling_cues.evidence_needed: excerpt must describe the agent's own operating behavior/task, not a business/market narrative about the company

nodes.definition: Business, financial, competitive, and policy developments in the AI industry, including company revenue, mergers and acquisitions, market rivalry, and government actions affecting AI labs.
include: AI company revenue, ARR, or financial performance figures
competitive rivalry or market-position claims between named AI labs or executives
AI company mergers, acquisitions, or major infrastructure and business deals
government policy or restrictions affecting a specific AI company's access to technology or markets
exclude: technical model architecture, scaling, or capability benchmarks -> AI and ML / Frontier Models
an agent or product demonstrating a real-world task rather than company financials or competition -> AI and ML / AI Agents and Automation
a finished AI-generated creative artifact shown as the output -> AI and ML / AI Generative Media

sibling_cues.include_cue: AI company revenue, ARR, or financial performance figures
sibling_cues.evidence_needed: quote must state a dollar figure, revenue, or financial comparison, not a capability/benchmark claim

sibling_cues.include_cue: competitive rivalry or market-position claims between named AI labs or executives
sibling_cues.confusing_alternative: AI Agents and Automation task demo
sibling_cues.evidence_needed: quote must be an executive/observer ranking companies competitively, not an agent performing a task

sibling_cues.include_cue: AI company mergers, acquisitions, or major infrastructure and business deals
sibling_cues.evidence_needed: quote must be about the deal/acquisition itself, not the acquired model's architecture or capability

sibling_cues.include_cue: government policy or restrictions affecting a specific AI company's access to technology or markets
sibling_cues.evidence_needed: quote must describe a policy/market consequence for a company, not a technical safety guardrail

nodes.definition: Practical guidance and firsthand accounts about job searching, launching or running an independent business or creative career, and non-traditional paths into a profession.
include: job search or hiring practice advice for an individual (e.g., avoiding mass-application pitfalls)
a solopreneur's daily routine of shipping or validating independent products
a person's self-taught or non-traditional path into a technical career
financial or business pacing advice for a creative professional or artist
a founder or entrepreneur interview covering how to start a startup
exclude: AI industry-wide financial or market trend without a personal career or business frame -> AI and ML / AI Industry and Business
a technical step-by-step tutorial aimed at skill-building rather than career/business strategy -> AI and ML / Education

sibling_cues.include_cue: job search or hiring practice advice for an individual (e.g., avoiding mass-application pitfalls)
sibling_cues.confusing_alternative: AI Industry and Business labor-market trend
sibling_cues.evidence_needed: quote frames it as an individual job-seeker's tactic, not an industry-wide labor trend

sibling_cues.include_cue: a solopreneur's daily routine of shipping or validating independent products
sibling_cues.confusing_alternative: AI Agents and Automation product feature
sibling_cues.evidence_needed: quote describes a personal work routine/shipping mindset, not a specific AI tool's features

sibling_cues.include_cue: a person's self-taught or non-traditional path into a technical career
sibling_cues.evidence_needed: quote narrates someone's career backstory/credentials, not a lesson teaching a skill

sibling_cues.include_cue: financial or business pacing advice for a creative professional or artist
sibling_cues.evidence_needed: quote gives concrete business/financial guidance (timing, spending), not artistic critique

sibling_cues.include_cue: a founder or entrepreneur interview covering how to start a startup
sibling_cues.confusing_alternative: AI Industry and Business company financial metrics
sibling_cues.evidence_needed: quote gives generalizable founding advice, not a specific company's revenue/market figures
